what: The Lorem Ipsum Generator makes placeholder text: Latin-looking words that fill a layout before the real text is ready. You choose how many paragraphs, sentences or words you want, from 1 to 100, and the text appears ready to copy.

Designers, web developers and students use it to fill website mock-ups, app screens, brochures, posters, slides and document templates. Dummy text lets people judge fonts, spacing and layout without being distracted by reading real content.
The text is created in your browser in an instant; nothing is sent anywhere.
uses: Fill page sections, cards and blog previews so the design looks finished.
Check how columns, headings and paragraphs fit on a flyer, magazine page or brochure.
See how a typeface, line height and text size look with a real-looking block of text.
Fill text fields with a set number of words or sentences to test limits and wrapping.
Show where text will go on a slide without writing the final words.
tutorial: When the page opens, 3 paragraphs of placeholder text are already in the box, starting with "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit."
Type a number from 1 to 100 in "How many". The text updates straight away.

In "Of", pick Paragraphs, Sentences or Words. Each paragraph has 4 to 7 sentences, each sentence has 8 to 17 words, and paragraphs are separated by an empty line. Words gives exactly that many words, ending with a full stop.
Keep or remove the classic start
"Start with "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet"" is ticked by default, so the text begins with the famous opening line. Untick it to start with random words instead, which looks less obviously like filler.
Click "Generate" to get different random text with the same settings.
Click "Copy" and paste the text into your design tool, web page, word processor or code.
features: Generate exactly the amount and kind of text your layout needs.
From a single word for a button to 100 paragraphs for a long page.
Optionally start with the well-known "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet" line.
Sentences vary in length, start with a capital letter, end with a full stop and sometimes include a comma.
Changing any setting creates new text at once.
Copy everything without selecting by hand.

example.title: Worked example: filling a blog card
example.text: A blog card in your design has space for a title of about 6 words and a short summary of 2 sentences. Set "How many" to 6 and "Of" to Words with the classic start ticked: you get "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur." for the title. Then set it to 2 Sentences and untick the classic start to get two random sentences for the summary, about 16 to 34 words in total. Paste each into the card and see if the text fits.

tips: Use about the same amount of dummy text as the real content will have, so the design is tested fairly.
Untick the classic start when you need several different blocks, so every card or column does not begin the same way.
Replace all placeholder text before publishing. Search your pages for "lorem" to find any you forgot.
Lorem ipsum has no real meaning, so do not use it where you are testing reading or understanding with real users.
problems: I asked for more than 100 and got only 100
The limit is 100 paragraphs, sentences or words per click. Generate more and copy again if you need a longer text.
Every block starts with the same words
The classic start is ticked. Untick "Start with "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet"" for random openings.
The paragraphs are joined when I paste
Some programs ignore the empty line between paragraphs. Paste as plain text, or add paragraph breaks by hand.
Your browser may block the clipboard. Click inside the text box, press Ctrl+A and then Ctrl+C.
